Class FineService

java.lang.Object
com.library.service.FineService
public class FineService extends Object
Service responsible for managing fines within the library system.

This includes:

  • Fetching user fines
  • Calculating overdue fines using FineCalculator
  • Creating fines for overdue items
  • Processing fine payments
  • Checking whether a user still owes money

All fine data is persisted through FileStorage.

    • createFineForOverdue

      public Fine createFineForOverdue(String userId, MediaType mediaType, long overdueDays)
      Creates a fine for an overdue item based on media type and number of overdue days. Fine calculation is delegated to FineCalculator.
      Parameters:
      userId - borrower user ID
      mediaType - type of borrowed item (BOOK or CD)
      overdueDays - number of days overdue
      Returns:
      the created fine, or null if the calculated amount is zero

    • payFine

      public double payFine(String userId, double amountToPay)
      Pays a portion or all of a user's outstanding fines.

      Payment is applied to the oldest fines first. Fines that are fully paid are marked as paid and set to amount = 0.

      Parameters:
      userId - user ID making the payment
      amountToPay - amount the user is paying
      Returns:
      new outstanding balance after the payment
